name: svelte-number-format
description: Lightweight currency, number and masked input components for Svelte 5. NumericFormat (currency, percent, decimal) & PatternFormat (phone, credit card, date) inputs, plus NumericText & PatternText for SSR-safe display.

paragraphs: svelte-number-format is a lightweight, reactive input-formatting library for Svelte 5: currency inputs, percentages, plain numbers, and pattern-based input masks (phone, credit card, dates) with caret-stable editing, two-way binding and Intl.NumberFormat localization. Inspired by react-number-format, with a compatible onValueChange API.
features: NumericFormat — locale-aware number input (currency, percentages, decimals)
PatternFormat — pattern-based input masking (phone, credit cards, dates, custom)
NumericText — display-only rendering of formatted numbers (no input)
PatternText — display-only rendering of masked strings (no input)

whatItDoes.text: svelte-number-format is a lightweight, reactive input-formatting library for Svelte 5: currency inputs, percentages, plain numbers, and pattern-based input masks (phone, credit card, dates) with caret-stable editing, two-way binding and Intl.NumberFormat localization. Inspired by react-number-format, with a compatible onValueChange API.

requirements.text: svelte-currency-input is a focused, well-made currency-only field — if that's all you need, it's a fine choice. svelte-number-format covers currency plus percent and decimal inputs, pattern masks (phone, credit card, dates, custom tokens), display-only components, and mirrors react-number-format's API.
